/*--------------------------------------------------------------*\ 
 * The LoadLibrary procedure attempts to load the specified
 * 3gl library file so the the functions within it can be
 * accessed.  It first of all checks to see if the Library
 * file is loaded already, and if it isn't does the load.
\*--------------------------------------------------------------*/

   PROCEDURE LoadLibrary IS
   BEGIN
	BEGIN
		lh_CUSTOMDLL := ORA_FFI.FIND_LIBRARY('CUSTOMDLL.dll');
	EXCEPTION
		WHEN ORA_FFI.FFI_ERROR THEN 
			lh_CUSTOMDLL := ORA_FFI.LOAD_LIBRARY(NULL,'CUSTOMDLL.dll');
	END;
   EXCEPTION
	WHEN OTHERS THEN
		-- Place the first error on the TOOL_ERR stack into the package header variables available for it.
		FFI_ERROR	:= TRUE;
		FFI_Error_Text	:= TOOL_ERR.MESSAGE;
		FFI_Error_Code	:= TOOL_ERR.CODE;
		FOR iErrors IN 1..TOOL_ERR.NERRORS LOOP
			Message('CUSTOMDLL: '||TOOL_ERR.MESSAGE);
			TOOL_ERR.POP;
		END LOOP;

		TOOL_ERR.CLEAR;

   END LoadLibrary;

   PROCEDURE fnCOMPORT(
			portno              	IN OUT	PLS_INTEGER
			)  IS
	l_portno                      	PLS_INTEGER	:= portno;
   BEGIN

	i_fnCOMPORT(
			fh_fnCOMPORT,
			l_portno);
	portno                        	:= l_portno;

   END fnCOMPORT;

   FUNCTION  Start_Send(
			Msg_ID1             	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			ECR_No1             	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			ECR_Recpt_No1       	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			Trans_Amt1          	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			Track_21            	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			addfield1a          	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			addfield2a          	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			addfield3a          	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			addfield4a          	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			addfield5a          	IN OUT	VARCHAR2
			)  RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
	RC                   		VARCHAR2(32000)	:= RPAD(' ',32000,CHR(0));
	l_Msg_ID1                     	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(Msg_ID1,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_ECR_No1                     	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(ECR_No1,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_ECR_Recpt_No1               	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(ECR_Recpt_No1,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_Trans_Amt1                  	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(Trans_Amt1,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_Track_21                    	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(Track_21,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_addfield1a                  	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(addfield1a,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_addfield2a                  	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(addfield2a,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_addfield3a                  	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(addfield3a,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_addfield4a                  	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(addfield4a,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_addfield5a                  	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(addfield5a,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
   BEGIN

	rc := i_Start_Send(
			fh_Start_Send,
			l_Msg_ID1,
			l_ECR_No1,
			l_ECR_Recpt_No1,
			l_Trans_Amt1,
			l_Track_21,
			l_addfield1a,
			l_addfield2a,
			l_addfield3a,
			l_addfield4a,
			l_addfield5a);
	Msg_ID1                       	:= l_Msg_ID1;
	ECR_No1                       	:= l_ECR_No1;
	ECR_Recpt_No1                 	:= l_ECR_Recpt_No1;
	Trans_Amt1                    	:= l_Trans_Amt1;
	Track_21                      	:= l_Track_21;
	addfield1a                    	:= l_addfield1a;
	addfield2a                    	:= l_addfield2a;
	addfield3a                    	:= l_addfield3a;
	addfield4a                    	:= l_addfield4a;
	addfield5a                    	:= l_addfield5a;
   RETURN RC;
   END Start_Send;

   PROCEDURE CloseRs232 IS
   BEGIN

	i_CloseRs232(
			fh_CloseRs232);

   END CloseRs232;

   FUNCTION  addtextpar(
			dest                	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			len                 	IN OUT	PLS_INTEGER
			)  RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
	RC                   		VARCHAR2(32000)	:= RPAD(' ',32000,CHR(0));
	l_dest                        	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(dest,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_len                         	PLS_INTEGER	:= len;
   BEGIN

	rc := i_addtextpar(
			fh_addtextpar,
			l_dest,
			l_len);
	dest                          	:= l_dest;
	len                           	:= l_len;
   RETURN RC;
   END addtextpar;

   FUNCTION  fnTerm_ID RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
	RC                   		VARCHAR2(32000)	:= RPAD(' ',32000,CHR(0));
   BEGIN

	rc := i_fnTerm_ID(
			fh_fnTerm_ID);
   RETURN RC;
   END fnTerm_ID;

   FUNCTION  OKKO(
			okko                	IN OUT	PLS_INTEGER
			)  RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
	RC                   		VARCHAR2(32000)	:= RPAD(' ',32000,CHR(0));
	l_okko                        	PLS_INTEGER	:= okko;
   BEGIN

	rc := i_OKKO(
			fh_OKKO,
			l_okko);
	okko                          	:= l_okko;
   RETURN RC;
   END OKKO;
